name: Shyamsundar Ravishankar
bio: Shyamsundar holds a PhD from the University of Adelaide and specialises in ancient DNA and population genetics.

name: Nicola Vogel
bio: Nicola develops methods for analysing ancient environmental DNA and is an expert in this field.

name: Michelle (Yuanyu) Cheng
bio: Michelle is a geographer with a PhD from McGill University and expertise in analysing environmental DNA from lake sediments.

name: Nare Ngoepe
bio: Nare studies past aquatic ecosystems and biodiversity using fish fossils and ancient DNA recovered from lake sediments.

name: Hannah-Marie Martiny
bio: Hannah holds a PhD from the Technical University of Denmark (DTU) and specialises in bacteria and ancient environmental DNA.
